intro: The future also guesses things about the present: «estará en casa» means «she is probably at home».
p.estará.consejo: With the future you guess the present: «estará en casa» means «she is probably at home».
p.será.consejo: For the time it agrees with it: «serán las diez», but «será la una».
p.tendrá.consejo: With ages: «tendrá unos treinta años». Remember that «tener» gains a «d»: «tendr-».
p.a lo mejor.consejo: It is followed by the indicative: «a lo mejor está en casa». With «quizá» the subjunctive also fits.
p.seguramente.consejo: It means «probably», not «with total certainty». For that you say «con seguridad».
p.supongo que.consejo: It is followed by the indicative: «supongo que llegará pronto». On its own, «supongo» also works.
p.me imagino que.consejo: It comes from «imaginarse», with «me». It is followed by the indicative: «me imagino que está cansada».
p.ni idea.consejo: It is a short, colloquial answer. The full sentence is «no tengo ni idea».
p.el atasco.consejo: It is masculine: «un atasco». In Mexico and other countries «embotellamiento» is also said.
p.la batería.consejo: It is also a musical instrument: «la batería». The context tells you which.
p.contestar.consejo: It takes «a» before what you answer: «contestar a una pregunta», «contestar al teléfono».
p.unos.consejo: Before a number it means «approximately»: «unos treinta años».
b1.texto:
The future does not only talk about tomorrow: it also **guesses something about the present** when you are not sure.

- ¿Dónde está Ana? — **Estará** en casa. (She is probably at home.)
- ¿Qué hora es? — **Serán** las diez.
- ¿Cuántos años tiene? — **Tendrá unos** treinta.

In a question it means «I wonder…»: **¿Quién será?** **¿Dónde estarán mis llaves?**

Compare **Está en casa** (I state it) with **Estará en casa** (I guess it). You can also say **a lo mejor está en casa**, **supongo que está en casa** or **seguramente está en casa**.
b2.f1.texto: I imagine she is stuck in traffic.
b2.f3.texto: Her battery has probably run out.
b2.f5.texto: I suppose she will arrive soon.
b2.f6.texto: Someone is knocking at the door.
b2.f7.texto: Who can it be at this hour?
b4.texto:
To guess something about the present, the verb goes in the future:

- **Está** en casa. → **Estará** en casa.
- **Son** las diez. → **Serán** las diez.
- **Tiene** treinta años. → **Tendrá unos** treinta.
- **Hay** un atasco. → **Habrá** un atasco.

After **a lo mejor**, **supongo que** and **me imagino que** the verb can already be in the present: **A lo mejor está** en casa. With **a lo mejor** the subjunctive is not used.
b4.e2.texto: There must be a traffic jam on the road.
b5.f0.texto: The platform smells of rain and warm metal.
b5.f1.texto: Lucía looks at the station clock every two minutes.
b5.f2.texto: Her friend Ana has to arrive at seven.
b5.f3.texto: A slow train enters platform two with a long screech.
b5.f4.texto: Hundreds of travellers get off the train with suitcases and wet umbrellas.
b5.f5.texto: Lucía looks for Ana among the unfamiliar faces.
b5.f6.texto: She can't find her and wonders where she can be.
b5.f7.texto: She thinks there must be a lot of traffic on the road.
b5.f8.texto: The phone suddenly rings inside her bag.
b5.f9.texto: A familiar voice laughs on the other end of the line and says she is already at the door.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: the future turns the sentence into a guess.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Son las diez» states the time as a fact.
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Eran» is the past, not a guess about the present.
b6.pregunta: You have no watch and guess the time. What is missing?
b7.o0.refuerzo: That would be «cumplirá cuarenta años». Here the age is guessed.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Correct: the future is a guess and «unos» gives an approximate number.
b7.o2.refuerzo: That would be «tenía». The future does not talk about the past.
b7.pregunta: What does «Tendrá unos cuarenta años» mean?
b8.traduccion: Who can it be at this hour?
b9.o0.refuerzo: The subjunctive is not used with «a lo mejor».
b9.o1.refuerzo: Well done! «A lo mejor» takes the indicative.
b9.o2.refuerzo: The infinitive does not work: you need a conjugated verb.
b10.o0.refuerzo: That's it: with the future you are no longer sure.
b10.o1.refuerzo: No: both sentences are about the present.
b10.o2.refuerzo: No: «estará» here is a guess about now.
b10.pregunta: What changes between «Está en casa» and «Estará en casa»?
b11.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «She must be at home.»
b12.o0.refuerzo: «Tiene» states a fact; you are only guessing.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Yes: the future of «tener» expresses the guess.
b12.pregunta: You guess why Ana doesn't answer. What is missing?
p.llama.consejo: «Llamar a la puerta» means to knock. The «ll» sounds like «y».
p.estas.consejo: It points to near feminine plural things: «estas horas». Without accent mark: «éstas» is old.
p.serán.consejo: For the time, it agrees with the hour: «serán las diez». The future here is a guess.
p.carretera.consejo: It is feminine: «la carretera». The «rr» is strong. It is for cars between towns.
p.metal.consejo: It is masculine: «el metal». The plural is «los metales».
p.amiga.consejo: It is the feminine of «amigo». The «g» before «a» sounds hard: «a-MI-ga».
p.vía.consejo: The accent mark on the «í» keeps «i» and «a» in separate syllables: «BÍ-a». It is feminine.
p.chirrido.consejo: It is masculine: «un chirrido». The «ch» is like English «ch» and the «rr» is strong.
p.cientos.consejo: Followed by «de»: «cientos de viajeros». It is a noun, so it is not shortened.
p.mojados.consejo: It comes from «mojar». The «j» sounds like «h». Here it agrees with «paraguas».
p.caras.consejo: It is the plural of «la cara». «Cara» sounds the same in singular and plural except the final «s».
p.desconocidas.consejo: It is the feminine plural of «desconocido»: «caras desconocidas». The prefix «des-» means not.
p.pasas.consejo: «Pasar de… a…» means to go from one thing to another: «pasas de afirmar a suponer».
p.suponer.consejo: It is conjugated like «poner»: «supongo», «supones». Its future is «supondré».
